# Cushion

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 19 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Async-messaging marketing sites: a #f5f5f5 page under a 72px sticky nav, #00a6f4 -> #0085c3 accent CTAs with a 2% press shrink, Inter Tight display (60px hero, 600) over a system-ui body, the --color-gray-1..-12 ramp (#fafafa panel / #fcfcfc surface / #858585 muted / #1f1f1f ink), rgba(33,33,33,.1) hairlines, 12px CTA and 16px panel radii, a rendered 'Acme Inc' inbox mock, $8/mo/user plan panel and a 72px FAQ accordion.

Captured 2026-11-12, signed out (every captured surface is public; the real app sits behind Log in / Sign up / Get started and was never reached; the 'Acme Inc' inbox on the home page is a marketing mock, not the authenticated product; no form was submitted and nothing was downloaded).. Themes: light.

Cushion's public signed-out surface — the marketing home with its embedded "Acme Inc" inbox mock, /pricing with the FAQ accordion, the /updates changelog, /blog, /download, /integrations, /slack-alternative and /terms — captured 2026-11-12 in headless Chromium at 1440 x 900, plus the home and pricing at 390 x 844. Cushion is an async-messaging app for small distributed teams; the signed-in app behind "Log in" / "Sign up" was never entered, and nothing was submitted or downloaded.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.
